name: djlint
description: HTML template formatter and linter (Django, Jinja, Twig, Nunjucks, Handlebars, Liquid, Go templates, Mustache, Tera, Askama)

scripts.vscode:prepublish: node ./build/minify-package-json.mjs && npm run assets && npm run esbuild-base -- --minify && npm run esbuild-worker -- --minify

djlint.blankLineAfterTag.markdownDescription: Add an additional blank line after `{% <tag> ... %}` tag groups. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.blankLineBeforeTag.markdownDescription: Add an additional blank line before `{% <tag> ... %}` tag groups. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.closeVoidTags.markdownDescription: Add closing mark on known void tags. Ex: `` becomes ``. Requires djLint ≥ 1.26.

djlint.configuration.description: Path to the configuration file. The path can be relative to the workspace root. Requires djLint ≥ 1.13 for .djlintrc format and ≥ 1.34 for TOML.

djlint.customBlocks.description: Indent custom template blocks. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.customHtml.description: Indent custom HTML tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.enableLinting.description: Lint for common issues. Don't enable globally, instead enable for each language individually.

djlint.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the djLint executable, used only when explicitly set. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Tried before `#djlint.interpreter#` and the active environment, regardless of `#djlint.useVenv#`.

djlint.exclude.description: Override the default exclude paths. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.extendExclude.description: Add additional paths to the default exclude. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.formatAttributeJsJson.description: Format JavaScript and JSON code inside HTML attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.0.

djlint.formatAttributeJsJsonMinProps.description: Minimum number of properties required in a JavaScript/JSON object for attribute formatting. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.0.

djlint.formatAttributeJsJsonPattern.description: Regex pattern for JavaScript/JSON attributes to format. Requires djLint ≥ 1.37.0.

djlint.formatAttributeTemplateTags.description: Attempt to format template syntax inside of tag attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.formatCss.markdownDescription: Also format contents of `<style>` tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.9.

djlint.formatLanguages.description: Language IDs for which djLint should be registered as a formatter.

djlint.formatJs.markdownDescription: Also format contents of `<script>` tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.9.

djlint.ignoreBlocks.description: Template blocks to not indent. Requires djLint ≥ 1.24.

djlint.ignoreCase.description: Do not fix case on known html tags. Requires djLint ≥ 1.23.

enumDescriptions: Use djLint from the environment, falling back to the bundled version if it is not found.

Use djLint from the environment; if it is not found, report an error instead of falling back to the bundled version. Ensures the exact djLint you configured is what runs. In an untrusted workspace the sandboxed bundled version is still used.
Always use the version of djLint bundled with the extension.
djlint.importStrategy.markdownDescription: Strategy for locating djLint. `fromEnvironment` uses your installed djLint (see `#djlint.useVenv#`), falling back to the bundled runtime. `fromEnvironmentStrict` uses your installed djLint but reports an error instead of falling back, guaranteeing the exact instance you configured. `useBundled` always uses the bundled runtime. Note: the bundled runtime applies djLint settings from VS Code but does not read project config files (`pyproject.toml [tool.djlint]`, `.djlintrc`); install djLint if you rely on those.

djlint.interpreter.markdownDescription: Path(s) to a Python interpreter to run djLint from (`python -m djlint`), tried in order until one succeeds. Takes precedence over the active environment. When empty, the active environment from the Python Environments (or Python) extension is used. Ignored when `#djlint.path#` resolves.

djlint.lineBreakAfterMultilineTag.description: Do not condense the content of multi-line tags into the line of the last attribute. Requires djLint ≥ 1.27.

djlint.lintLanguages.markdownDescription: Language IDs djLint will lint. Combined with `#djlint.enableLinting#`, so enabling linting globally (rather than per language) still only lints these languages.

djlint.maxBlankLines.description: Consolidate blank lines down to x lines. Requires djLint ≥ 1.31.

djlint.noFunctionFormatting.description: Do not attempt to format function contents. Requires djLint ≥ 1.30.2.

djlint.noLineAfterYaml.description: Do not add a blank line after yaml front matter. Requires djLint ≥ 1.29.

djlint.noSetFormatting.description: Do not attempt to format set contents. Requires djLint ≥ 1.30.2.

djlint.path.markdownDescription: Path(s) to the djLint executable, tried in order until one succeeds. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Takes precedence over `#djlint.interpreter#`.

djlint.preserveBlankLines.description: Attempt to preserve blank lines. Requires djLint ≥ 1.3.

djlint.preserveClassNewlines.description: Preserve line breaks inside multiline class attributes. Requires djLint ≥ 1.39.0.

djlint.preserveLeadingSpace.description: Attempt to preserve leading space on text. Requires djLint ≥ 1.2.

djlint.profile.description: Enable defaults by template language. Requires djLint ≥ 0.4.5; the askama, tera and liquid profiles require djLint ≥ 1.42.

djlint.requirePragma.markdownDescription: Only format or lint files that start with a comment with the text `djlint:on`. Requires djLint ≥ 0.5.8.

djlint.rules.description: Path to a custom rules file in .djlint_rules.yaml format. The path can be relative to the workspace root. Requires djLint ≥ 1.41.

djlint.showInstallError.markdownDescription: Show an error message when djLint is not found in the configured environment and `#djlint.importStrategy#` is `fromEnvironmentStrict` (no bundled fallback available). With the default `fromEnvironment` (or `useBundled`) strategy, the bundled runtime is used silently instead and this setting has no effect.

djlint.singleAttributePerLine.description: When an opening tag wraps, put each attribute on its own line. Requires djLint ≥ 1.40.

djlint.useEditorIndentation.markdownDescription: Get the number of indent spaces from VS Code (see the `#editor.tabSize#` setting). Disable to get it from the djLint config file. Requires djLint ≥ 0.4.3.

djlint.useGitignore.description: Use .gitignore file to extend excludes. Requires djLint ≥ 0.5.9.

djlint.useNewLinterOutputParser.markdownDescription: Use a new, more reliable linter output parser. If you disable this setting, make sure that you have not changed the `linter_output_format` setting in the djLint configuration file. Requires djLint ≥ 1.25.

djlint.useVenv.markdownDescription: Use the Python executable from the current active environment as a fallback when `#djlint.path#`, `#djlint.executablePath#`, and `#djlint.interpreter#` don't resolve. Disable this to skip that fallback and use `djlint` from PATH instead.
djlint.useVenv.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use djlint.interpreter and djlint.importStrategy instead.

virtualWorkspaces.description: A djLint installed in your environment cannot be used in a virtual workspace; the bundled runtime is used instead, and project config files are not read.
